thought.text: Let me check the cargo installs progress and the valhalla tiles.

reasoning_content:
Let's check the progress of the cargo installation and look at the status of the valhalla tile directory (whether it exists or not).

The valhalla tile is built from `ghcr.io/green-ecolution/streamlet/pbf-patch:latest` and `ghcr.io/green-ecolution/streamlet/generate-valhalla:latest`. Let's check if it already exists.

action.command: ls -la /workspace/.docker/infra/valhalla/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---custom_files---"; ls -la /workspace/.docker/infra/valhalla/custom_files 2>/dev/null; echo "---tar exists?---"; test -f /workspace/.docker/infra/valhalla/custom_files/valhalla_tiles.tar && echo "TAR EXISTS" || echo "NO TAR - needs build"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "ls -la /workspace/.docker/infra/valhalla/ 2>/dev/null; echo \"---custom_files---\"; ls -la /workspace/.docker/infra/valhalla/custom_files 2>/dev/null; echo \"---tar exists?---\"; test -f /workspace/.docker/infra/valhalla/custom_files/valhalla_tiles.tar && echo \"TAR EXISTS\" || echo \"NO TAR - needs build\"", "summary": "Check valhalla tiles presence", "security_risk": "UNKNOWN"}
